R_note: J/(kg·K), pure CO2 (8.314/0.04401). Mars air (~95 % CO2) is ~191: density is ~1 % high.

rad.src: Hassler et al. 2014, Science 343, 1244797, doi:10.1126/science.1244797 (0.210 ± 0.040 mGy/day; value not re-checked against the paper, the abstract does not state it)

uv.note: ≈8 % of 1361 W/m² (ASTM E-490 AM0); approximate, not re-checked

tau.note: ARIADNE seasonal curve shaped on Jezero values (~0.4–0.6 around aphelion, higher in dust season); MODEL

hazard.note: ARIADNE operational thresholds, not NASA rules

wind_model.note: 3 + 4·max(0, sin(π·(LTST − 9)/8)) m/s: daytime convection, calm nights. MODEL where MEDA has no wind (sensor damaged early in the mission).

storm_ref: MY34 global storm: τ ≈ 8.5 at Gale (Guzewich et al. 2019, doi:10.1029/2018GL080839)
